description: This Java source file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named ShippingQuoteResponse, which represents the response payload received from the shipping-service API endpoint /api/shipping/quotes. It includes metadata annotations for API documentation and describes the structure of the shipping quote response, including a list of quote options.

classes.name: ShippingQuoteResponse
classes.description: A record representing the shipping quote response, including request ID, timestamp, currency, and a list of individual quotes.

classes.name: Quote
classes.description: A nested record representing a single shipping quote option, including provider, service level, service name, and amount.
